item.title: Network Infrastructure Product Selection: Strategic Criteria and Field Experiences
item.description: Why is product selection in enterprise network projects more than a technical checklist? A field-tested framework for evaluating Firewalls, Switches, and APs — beyond datasheets and vendor promises.

item.title: Switch, Firewall, AP — Why Choosing the Right Products Is Not Enough
item.description: Most enterprise network projects fail not because of wrong products, but because of fragmented architecture. A deep-dive into firewall, switching, AP selection, capacity planning, and vendor reality from 11+ years of field experience.

item.title: IT Infrastructure Is Not a Collection of Products — It's a System
item.description: Most IT infrastructure projects fail not because of bad products, but because the environment never becomes a system. This foundational article sets the architectural baseline for the Core Network series.
